automatic.algorithm: combine approved normalized parent display names; deterministic collision suffix

custom.cost: USD 4.20 target, paid in native $420 using finalized seven-day reference average

feePolicy.updateCadence: once per calendar week, after period closes
feePolicy.aggregation: time-weighted mean over verified observations covering seven days, stale/outlier and minimum observation guards
feePolicy.calculation: ceil(4.20 USD / reference USD per 420 token to token base units)
feePolicy.snapshot: fee quote bound to oracle period, rule version, expiry and request ID
feePolicy.failure: fail closed for new custom-name quotations on stale/missing/invalid oracle; free auto names continue
feePolicy.upperBound: subject to approved affordability bounds and emergency pause; not activated yet
feePolicy.ownerControls: scoped authorized emergency stop and future version updates, not retroactive repricing

notice: Cultivar names must not contain identity-based slurs, hateful language, threats, harassment, explicit sexual content, vulgar or obscene language, disguised prohibited terms, impersonation, or attempts to bypass moderation. Violating names and associated cultivars may be blocked from use in High Country. Repeated violations may result in suspension or removal from the game. Legitimate genetic provenance remains recorded.
filterLayers: normalized deterministic prohibited term checks including confusables and obfuscation
context-sensitive automated moderation with uncertainty quarantine
human appeal and review with evidence and independent audit

reviewerCompensation.payoutModel: fixed amount per independently qualified completed review; same for approval and denial
reviewerCompensation.rewardAmount: 50% of accepted custom naming fee, initially 2.5 $420
reviewerCompensation.payer: funded custom naming escrow, paid on qualified final review independently of approve/reject decision
reviewerCompensation.capPerPeriod: Governance-controlled payout and throughput cap; operational values pending

customNameEconomics.settlement: escrow upon accepted submission; release once per eligible final review; idempotent; no self review
customNameEconomics.feeChanges: weekly time-averaged USD 4.20 target; quote frozen at acceptance; fee may increase or decrease as USD value changes

moderatorGovernance.appointment: owner nominates authenticated account, verifies identity and conflicts, assigns scoped time-limited capability via HighCountryAuthorization/CapabilityRegistry; require MFA and revocable roles
moderatorGovernance.separation: reviewers cannot approve own name, review their own appeal, change payout terms, whitelist prohibited slurs, or unilaterally alter rulesets
moderatorGovernance.discipline: documented error review; non-punitive coaching for reasonable mistake; warnings and retraining for repeated negligence; suspended reviewing and unpaid future assignments for reckless or intentional violations; revoke capability/remove for deliberate abuse; clawback only upon proved fraud under separately approved rules; provide appeal and audit
moderatorGovernance.pay: only independently qualified completed cases, same payout approve/reject, one eligible payment per request/revision; no action-volume self-generation
